import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Calculate correlations and identify near-duplicates
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(ids[j])
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    filtered_ids = [id for id in ids if id not in to_remove]
    filtered_indices = [i for i, id in enumerate(ids) if id not in to_remove]
    filtered_x = x[:, filtered_indices]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(filtered_ids):
        group0 = filtered_x[y==0, i]
        group1 = filtered_x[y==1, i]
        mean_diff = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        effect_sizes.append((abs(mean_diff), fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size and select top candidates
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    candidates = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:10]]
    
    # Select top drivers based on t-test significance
    drivers = []
    for fid in candidates:
        idx = filtered_ids.index(fid)
        group0 = filtered_x[y==0, idx]
        group1 = filtered_x[y==1, idx]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1)
        if abs(t_stat) > 5.0:  # threshold for significance
            drivers.append(fid)
            if len(drivers) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
                break
    
    # If no strong drivers found, return empty design
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build regression features
    columns = drivers[:]
    loadings = {}
    products = []
    
    # Add interaction terms for top drivers
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        products.append((drivers[0], drivers[1]))
        
    # Add loading for main effects
    for fid in drivers:
        idx = filtered_ids.index(fid)
        group0 = filtered_x[y==0, idx]
        group1 = filtered_x[y==1, idx]
        mean_diff = np.mean(group1) - np.mean(group0)
        loadings[fid] = mean_diff
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
